**Question.** Does native DFlash2 move the c8 CUDA engine above the 20.6 tokens/s per-stream EXL3 vLLM result?

| setup | |
| --- | --- |
| node | `gx10-5e36` and peer, 2x NVIDIA GB10 |
| target fuel | GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4, BF16 tensor-core projection path |
| draft | GLM-5.3-Flash DFlash2 BF16, one bonus plus seven masks |
| commit | `3ccd6aec1eb571ab2b34a6b52ca61469d79d6f81` |

```bash
ROCKET_FUEL_NVFP4_DIR=$HOME/.cache/rocket-fuels/glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4 \
ROCKET_PACKED_WEIGHTS=$HOME/.cache/rocket-fuels/glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4/resident-packed.bin \
ROCKET_FP8_ATTN_DIR=$HOME/.cache/rocket-fuels/overlays \
ROCKET_KDA_CUBLAS=1 ROCKET_CUBLAS_ALL=1 \
ROCKET_DFLASH2_DIR=$HOME/.cache/rocket-glm53-exl3-host/models/glm-5.3-flash-dflash2 \
ROCKET_RDMA_WAIT_S=120 GLM53_ALLOW_LAUNCH=1 EXPERT_CACHE_GIB=90 \
BATCH=8 SPEC=8 TOKENS=256 \
PROMPT='Count from 1 to 200. Output only the numbers, separated by spaces. No other text.' \
scripts/runtime/glm53-nvfp4-spec-bench.sh
```

```text
spec rounds=33 drafted=1848 accepted=1776 + committed=264 (96.1% draft acceptance)
decode median 323.2 ms/step (191.26 agg tok/s at batch 8, 23.91 tok/s/stream)
dflash2 propose 20.8 ms median
dflash2 context 0.2 ms median
```

| metric | replicated head | sharded head | 256-token gate | unit |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| per-stream throughput, rank 0 | 24.10 | 24.34 | 23.91 | tokens/s |
| aggregate throughput, rank 0 | 192.77 | 194.72 | 191.26 | tokens/s |
| median full round | 303.3 | 300.2 | 323.2 | ms |
| draft acceptance | 90.1 | 90.1 | 96.1 | % |
| DFlash2 proposal | 21.8 | 18.6 | 20.8 | ms |
| accepted draft tokens | 656 | 656 | 1776 | tokens |

Both ranks produced the same token sequence, acceptance count, and round count in every run.

| c8 draft depth | acceptance | throughput | unit |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 2 | 95.5 | 14.50 | tokens/s/stream |
| 3 | 94.1 | 17.13 | tokens/s/stream |
| 4 | 92.9 | 19.54 | tokens/s/stream |
| 7 | 96.1 | 23.91 | tokens/s/stream |

| concurrency | throughput/stream | aggregate | unit |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 4 | 31.56 | 126.24 | tokens/s |
| 8 | 23.91 | 191.26 | tokens/s |

The c16 allocation did not reach model load with 4096 or 512 token capacity in 10 minutes. Both attempts were stopped without a measurement.

**Verdict.** Accepted. The 256-token gate is 23.91 tokens/s per stream, 16.1% above 20.6. The measured c8 optimum is seven draft tokens.

**Reopen if.**

- A vLLM release produces more than 23.91 tokens/s per stream under the same 256-token c8 protocol on two GB10 nodes.
